style: Theatrical vaudeville folk-rock band. Harmony: modal drone harmony with ringing barbershop dominant tension and non-diatonic cluster rubs. Melody: fast chromatic cabaret patter opening into wide sustained vowels with downward yodel register flips. Rhythm: swing triplet subdivisions invading a waltz pulse with metric compression and stop-start silence. Timbre: upright bass, brushed snare, barrelhouse piano, banjo, and bowed saw with room bleed. Performance: deadpan administrative precision colliding with ecstatic theatrical overstatement. Production: dry 1960s mono-to-stereo room capture with sudden dynamic dropouts and spatial throws. Hold the waltz pulse fixed while accelerating the cabaret patter against it. Compress the instrumental density while stretching vocal vowels. Make the banjo behave like a brass section without losing acoustic warmth. Preserve the swinging triplet meter while destabilizing downbeats. Return to the core waltz anchor in a more mutated harmonic form.
lyrics: [SCENE START] [TEMPO: FAST WALTZ WITH SWINGING TRIPLETS] [INSTRUMENTATION: UPRIGHT BASS, BRUSHED SNARE, BARRELHOUSE PIANO, BANJO, BOWED SAW] [VERSE 1] [DEADPAN SPOKEN NARRATION] The geometric container has ingested twelve flagons of fermented grain. Observe the vertices swelling into soft, gelatinous lobes. [RAPID PATTER] One edge dips south, another climbs north, the third has forgotten its coordinate completely! [VOCAL HARMONY: TIGHT BARBERSHOP CLOSE VOICING] Pour another pint for the obtuse triangle! It is hiccuping in radians! [CHORUS] [ECSTATIC THEATRICAL OVERSTATEMENT] Tesseract on the table! Tesseract on the floor! It cannot hold its liquor or its dimensions anymore! The fourth axis is spinning like a drunk top in the hall! (Yodel register flip) Watch it stumble through the wall! [POST-CHORUS] [INSTRUMENTAL BREAK: BANJO AND BARRELHOUSE PIANO CLUSTER RUBS] [RHYTHMIC STOP] [SPOKEN] Calculating blood-alcohol content of the fourth spatial coordinate. Result: catastrophic overflow. [VERSE 2] [RAPID CABARET PATTER] The Euclidean bouncer escorts the polyhedron outside into the alley. It tries to project a hyper-cube shadow but misses the pavement entirely. [MELISMA] Oh, the longitudinal lines are blurring into gin-soaked twine! [HARMONIC SHIFT: NON-DIATONIC CLUSTER RUBS] We measured the perimeter twice; now it has five corners and a headache. [CHORUS] [MASSING VOICES] Tesseract on the table! Tesseract on the floor! It cannot hold its liquor or its dimensions anymore! The fourth axis is spinning like a drunk top in the hall! Watch it stumble through the wall! [BRIDGE] [HOCKETED SYLLABLES PASSED BETWEEN VOICES] Hic-cup! Dimension-drop! Volume-leak! Angle-peak! Hold the corner, catch the glass, watch the perpendicular pass! [SLOW DOWN] [RUBATO VOCAL TIMING] The hyper-surface is sweating clear ethanol and non-Euclidean regret. [BUILD UP] [ACCELERATION CUE: ROLLED CONSONANTS] Tr-tr-tr-trans-dimensional stagger! [GUITAR AND BANJO SURGE] [VERSE 3] [DEADPAN RECISITATIVE] Administrative audit confirms the spatial vessel is legally intoxicated. All internal dihedral angles exceed the municipal limit. [FAST SCAT SYLLABLES] Bap-da-zoot-zop, angle-hop, hiccup in the topological shop! [CHORUS] [FULL ENSEMBLE EXPLOSION] Tesseract on the table! Tesseract on the floor! It cannot hold its liquor or its dimensions anymore! The fourth axis is spinning like a drunk top in the hall! Watch it stumble through the wall! [OUTRO] [DRY DYNAMIC DROPOUT] One final lurch. [BOWED SAW SUSTAINED DRONE] The container collapses back into a sober, uninteresting cube of ice. [STOP] [SPOKEN DEADPAN] Case closed.
caption: A theatrical vaudeville folk-rock performance exploring a geometrically intoxicated tesseract through swinging waltz rhythms, tight barbershop harmony, deadpan administrative narration, and sudden dynamic dropouts.
